primary.poolable_reason: ALL 2 of 2 SEEDED REGISTRATIONS REGISTER NO CLINICAL ENDPOINT AT ANY RANK ON THE QUANTITY THIS REVIEW WAS ASKED TO POOL. Every registration on this page was read on 2026-08-18 at ALL THREE RANKS -- primary, secondary and other outcome measures -- from ClinicalTrials.gov. Registrations read: NCT02285998, NCT05144945. AUTHORITY: Cochrane Handbook 6.5 (2024) section 8.7, RoB 2 domain 5, bias in selection of the reported result, which covers outcome measures 'added to, the results report, post hoc'. Eligibility is chapter 3's business and registration status is not among its criteria, so nothing here is excluded on eligibility; and section 10.10.3, 'A systematic review need not contain any meta-analyses.'

primary.what_this_verdict_does_not_establish: THIS IS A STATEMENT ABOUT THE REGISTRATION, NOT ABOUT THE TRIAL. It does NOT establish that clinical outcomes were not measured -- they may well have been measured and published, and the published figures may be entirely correct. It does NOT establish that any trial here was conducted or reported improperly: a trial designed as an immunogenicity, safety or pharmacokinetic study that registers immunogenicity, safety or pharmacokinetic endpoints IS BEHAVING CORRECTLY. What it establishes is that a SYNTHESIS on this page pooled a clinical quantity that none of these registrations pre-specified, and the criticism belongs on that pooling and nowhere else. The registry is a live document; this reads its contents on the date recorded and a later amendment could change it.
primary.poolable_DEPRECATED_note: `poolable` MEANT ONLY 'the source page pooled these trials'. It was never a judgement that the pool was sound, and the renderer read it as permission to assert 'pooled on the X scale'. RENAMED to source_page_pooled, which is what it says. `poolable` is retained so nothing breaks, and it is DEPRECATED: read source_page_pooled for what the source did, and estimand_established for whether the pool is defensible. A PAGE SHOULD DISPLAY A POOLED ESTIMATE BECAUSE ITS ESTIMAND WAS ESTABLISHED, NOT BECAUSE SOMEONE ONCE POOLED IT.
primary.estimand_established_means: TRUE only where every contributing trial has been READ and shown to measure the same quantity, or the same construct with a variance stated. FALSE where that was checked and failed. NULL where it was never checked -- AN ABSENT ASSERTION AND A NEGATIVE ONE ARE DIFFERENT STATES and null is not a pass.
primary.estimand_established_does_not_cover_the_: READ THIS BESIDE `estimand_established`. That flag records that every contributing trial measures the SAME QUANTITY. It records NOTHING about what that quantity was measured AGAINST -- whether the comparators are of one kind, whether each comparison was randomised, whether it was concurrent. The two questions were never separated. Named as P48 in PAGE-STANDARD.md v1.21.0 and swept by scripts/audit_mixed_contrast_pools.py.

risk_of_bias_verdict: RoB 2 domain 5 (Handbook 6.5 section 8.7), bias in selection of the reported result, would be graded HIGH for every trial marked clinical_endpoint_at_any_rank=false, with the registry enumeration as the evidence. No pooled result is published here, so no further domain is graded.

handbook_authority.handbook: Cochrane Handbook for Systematic Reviews of Interventions
handbook_authority.sections: 8.7 (bias in selection of the reported result); 10.10.3; 10.14
handbook_authority.ruling: An endpoint absent from its own registration is a RISK OF BIAS question, not an eligibility one. Chapter 3 and MECIR Box 3.2.d discourage outcome-based exclusion; chapter 13 recommends detection, a risk-of-bias judgement and sensitivity analysis, never exclusion.

manuscript.introduction:
This review asks: In Quadrivalent recombinant influenza vaccine in adults versus licensed inactivated influenza vaccine, is there a registered clinical endpoint that the contributing trials can be pooled on?

It identifies no trial that can be pooled.

The outcome sought is the quantity this review was asked to pool.

Everything in this paragraph is derived from stored fields and none of it is authored. The interpretive sentences that follow are marked as drafts and are the author's to replace.

bookkeeping_2026_08_21._what: The five reporting claims a PRISMA-2020 manuscript needs that are FETCHABLE rather than argued -- each derived from a field here, or stated as an honest absence.
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.which_limbs_this_review_refuses: Of the four properties this project requires of a completed topic, 0 are held (none) and 4 are refused with the obstacle named in the evidence (comparison denominator, grade per pool, model output verbatim, rob per result).
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.the_search_its_date_and_its_databases: PRIMARY TRIALS. NO BIBLIOGRAPHIC SEARCH FOR PRIMARY TRIALS WAS RUN. The 2 included trials were identified by reading named registrations on 2026-08-18. Every seeded registration read from ClinicalTrials.gov on 2026-08-18 at all three outcome ranks: primaryOutcomes, secondaryOutcomes and otherOutcomes. The ranks read and the per-trial verdict are recorded on each trial row.
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.whether_this_review_was_prospectively_re: NO PROSPERO REGISTRATION OR PROTOCOL RECORD IS HELD ON THIS OBJECT. That is not the same as knowing this review was not registered, and neither claim is made. It is recorded here as an absence so that a reader does not have to infer it from silence.
bookkeeping_2026_08_21.that_two_assessors_disagreed_and_where: NO SECOND, INDEPENDENT RISK-OF-BIAS ASSESSMENT IS RECORDED FOR THIS TOPIC. The judgements were made once. Stated so that single assessment is not mistaken for agreement between two.
